name: Centaur Bracers
summary: Across the Barrens, Centaur Bracers are stripped from slain Kolkar warriors. Regthar Deathgate gathers them west of the Crossroads as proof that centaur raiders have been culled.

sections.title: A Gritty Bounty
sections.body: Kolkar raiders threaten the Horde’s foothold across the Barrens. Their fallen warriors leave behind leather and iron bracers, proof that a raider has been removed from the trade roads. Regthar Deathgate, an orc scout stationed on the bluffs west of the Crossroads, offers a standing bounty for these trophies to curb the tribe’s aggression.

faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate, a Horde scout camped on a rise west of the Crossroads in the Barrens, accepts the bracers as proof of your efforts against the local Kolkar centaur.
Kolkar warriors wear these bracers as they roam the northern Barrens’ oases and encampments, including the Forgotten Pools and Lushwater Oasis.

faq.q: Why does Regthar want them collected?
faq.answer: Regthar wants the Kolkar numbers reduced to protect Horde territory. The bracers show that warriors have killed marauders instead of merely driving them off.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help protect caravan supply lines between Durotar, Mulgore, and the Crossroads when you take down Kolkar raiders.
As a tauren, you know your people have endured generations of brutal harassment by centaur clans. Clearing Kolkar from the Barrens brings retribution and security.
